## Personality

Levi Gammon is characterized by a stingy nature and a lack of generosity. These traits make him unwilling to devote the necessary time to his endeavors.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P1](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0001), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)_
